author: TIM SEAMAN
title: SCCSD Associate Superintendent will not seek Superintendent position - NewsBreak
text:
By TIM SEAMAN Maren Ewertz ,
1 hours ago SIOUX CITY , Iowa ( KCAU ) — More information has been released concerning a pair of local school administrators.
Sioux City Community School District Associate Superintendent Angela Bemus will not be part of the district’s path moving forward concerning the now-vacant superintendent’s job.
The associate superintendent has notified school board members that she will not be a candidate for an interim superintendent role.
Story continues below
Additionally, Bemus indicated that she no longer wants to fill the superintendent’s role in the district. She was initially expected to fill the role through March.
In the email, Bemus said her decision is based on her assessment that there is not sufficient clarity or alignment around the board’s vision, expectations, and trust necessary for an interim or permanent superintendent to be successful at this time.
The school board is expected to again address a process for filling the vacant superintendent job at its next meeting on February 9.
